entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not for me. There was an emergency, so I'm only just now getting to it.
I'm sorry to hear that. Let me just pull up your order details with your phone number... one moment please.
Alright, I see your order here. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th.
Yes, and I'm sure you're going to tell me that's too long ago. Look, my brother needed emergency surgery, and I was at the hospital for weeks. It was chaos.

I'm truly sorry to hear about your brother. But actually, there's no issue at all. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you're well within the timeframe. I can process this for you right now.
Oh. You're just approving it? I was getting ready for a whole thing.
No 'whole thing' necessary. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. Do you still have access to that one?
Yeah, I have it. It's just... with everything going on, it felt like a military deployment trying to get our family organized. I didn't have time for this.

I completely understand. I'm glad I could make this part easy for you. Just print that label, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund in 5-7 business days.
Whatever. As long as it's done. Thanks, I guess.
You're very welcome. I hope your brother has a smooth recovery. Is there anything else I can assist with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
